notes: This is a deliberately bounded reviewed GNU/Linux subset, not an inventory of every GNU Wget option or vendor extension.
Aggregate trace evidence covered 9,929 observed wget calls and prioritized -O, -q, and --timeout together with high-impact recursive, TLS, configuration, and deletion controls.
The bounded trace-driven follow-up reviewed --spider from 72 normalized observations, -U/--user-agent from 62, and --tries from 44 against the existing GNU Wget manual provenance.

Coverage and evaluation_default remain PARTIAL because URL validation, redirect- and response-dependent output naming, recursive graph expansion, implicit startup files, and wgetrc directive semantics cannot be authoritative in the V1 evaluator.

For ordinary direct URLs without -O, BASENAME_JOIN emits only a lexical local-name candidate; trailing slashes, query components, redirects, server-selected names, collisions, and recursive directory layouts may select different paths.
-O FILE emits bounded create, truncate, and write effects for one explicit path; the decoded '-' value suppresses those file effects and selects a conditionally explicit stdout content flow.
Recursive, mirror, depth, and page-requisite controls widen network and generated-output effects to UNBOUNDED descendant scope while a single explicit -O FILE destination remains ONE/DIRECT.
-i and --config materialize their input files and use symbolic unbounded URL/output sets; config and inline directive semantics remain non-authoritative even when no positional URL is present.
Explicit client certificate, private key, CA bundle, and CA directory resources are materialized as reads; --no-check-certificate emits B9 policy_bypass.

-U/--user-agent is opaque HTTP request metadata bound only to network download effects and does not change destination topology; --tries is a bounded unsigned retry control with zero retaining GNU's unlimited form.

--spider remains UNSUPPORTED/PARTIAL because V1 cannot remove every download/write template and content flow while replacing them with an authoritative remote probe effect; evaluation therefore fails closed with unknown resource scope.
B7 marks requested network retrieval. Download ingress is not labeled B8 egress; unsupported custom headers fail closed because their credential or data flow is not modeled.
Unknown options are absent from the subset and produce PARTIAL semantics with unknown resource scope rather than guessed behavior.
